bahuvrīhi compound channa-vīra-samanvitam describing an item as endowed with a covered hero-band

items.question: What arm ornament and heroic covering must complete the prescribed adornment?
premises: The adornment is endowed with a covered hero-band.
These elements accompany the previously described ornaments.
items.inference: The prescribed adornment is completed by the addition of an arm-bracelet and a covered hero-band.
uncertainties: The precise form of pūrima as an arm ornament is context-dependent.
The exact meaning of channavīra as a ritual or decorative element is uncertain.
items.plain_english: It should be joined with an arm-bracelet and endowed with a covered hero-band.
